title: F-16 Internal Vent & Pressure Valve Repair
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO MN.USPFO MN PROCUREMENT.W7NG USPFO ACTIVITY MNANG 148
detail_text: The 148th Fighter Wing has a requirement for two (2) F-16 Internal Vent and Pressure Valves to be diagnosed and repaired. Details can be found below: Internal Vent and Pressure Valves Quantity: 2 Original Manufacturer: Parker-Hannafin NSN: 4810-01-054-9843 ------------------------------------------------------------------- Please respond to the following questions: 1. Is your company capable of evaluation/diagnostics and repairing/overhauling of these parts in accordance with Technical Order specifications and military aviation safety standards? 2. Does your firm have an approved Source of Approved Request (SAR) by the F-16 System Program Office (SPO)? 3. Is your firm projected to be AFREP SAR approved in the next 30 calendar days? 4. Is you firm an approved FAA-certified repair station for military and commercial avionics? 5. Please list your average turnaround time.
